summary: Thunder Bridge Capital Partners V, Ltd., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 30,015,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option, for gross proceeds of $300,150,000. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The filing details standard IPO agreements: underwriting agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald, amended articles, warrant agreement, and trust agreement. This is a routine SPAC IPO filing, not a special situation business combination or transaction. No target, acquisition, or strategic event is announced. What to watch: future announcement of a de-SPAC merger target.
